thread:
elisabeth_docs: FYI I'm rolling up a short migration note for the Console tracing hook auto-linking change (we now auto-link traces -> cost/latency metrics when trace.id is present). Need tiny SDK snippets for Python + Go that show adding trace.id to the request header, and a docs redirect for the old tracing guide URL.

mehul: Good call. Keep snippets minimal. For Python show how to add header in requests: one-liner. For Go, a small http.Client RoundTripper that sets X-Trace-Id.

ryan_sre: Also add a short troubleshooting bullet: if you don't see links, check that traces have 16+ hex chars (our match rule) and that the Console route used the new ingestion pipeline.

samira: I'll add the snippets and open a PR. Also found a stale link in tracers/README -> /tracing/old-guide which 404s; should redirect to /tracing/overview. Will include link fix.

elisabeth_docs: Include a one-line note in the migration: "No change required for most users; only instrumented apps that attach trace IDs manually may need the header key update." Keep language non-technical.

mehul: Example Python snippet suggestion:

```python
# add trace id header
import requests
requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={'X-Trace-Id':'abcd1234ef567890'})
```

And Go example:

```go
// RoundTripper that adds trace id
rt := RoundTripperFunc(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
  r.Header.Set("X-Trace-Id", "abcd1234ef567890")
  return http.DefaultTransport.RoundTrip(r)
})
client := &http.Client{Transport: rt}
```

samira: Added both to PR #1270 with short explanatory text and a deploy preview path: https://deploy-preview-1270--docs.redwood.ai/tracing/auto-link. I also added the redirect PR for /tracing/old-guide -> /tracing/overview.
